target.purpose: Capture the QEMU-visible boundary and data-access contract needed to validate a future whole-kernel accelerator.

repeatability.reason: Independent boots did not begin from identical register state and produced different accessed-address topology. Counts alone are not an acceleration oracle.

record_replay.result: Both replays timed out before native sample assignment.

next_gate: Create an identical kernel entry state by boundary snapshot/restore or same-process shadow execution, then require strict native-versus-accelerated agreement.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: The live trace was deleted after aggregate validation. No firmware, guest register values, guest addresses from a run, sample names, project data, or PCM are committed.
